cards.meaning: fake, counterfeit, not genuine — especially of an identity or claim, not just an object
cards.example: Inamin ng abogado na huwad ang mga pangalan sa listahan.
cards.exampleMeaning: The lawyer admitted the names on the list were fake.
cards.note: Mas mabigat ang dating kaysa sa karaniwang 'peke' — mas madalas gamit sa balita o sa korte kapag pagkakakilanlan ng tao ang tinatanong, hindi lang basta produkto. Kapatid na salita: 'impostor' kapag tao mismo ang tinutukoy.
cards.tiesTo: Duterte impeachment trial — confidential-fund payee aliases admitted

cards.meaning: a splitting apart, a breaking away — the process/result of a group or alliance dividing
cards.example: Ang paghihiwalay ng BFP mula sa UBJP ay nagulat sa marami.
cards.exampleMeaning: The BFP's breakaway from the UBJP surprised many.
cards.note: Iba sa 'hidwaan,' na tumutukoy sa alitan o tunggalian mismo. Ang paghihiwalay ay ang resulta — kapag talagang naghiwalay na ang mga panig at magkahiwalay na ang landas, hindi na basta nag-aaway lamang.
cards.tiesTo: First BARMM Parliament election — BFP breakaway from MILF's UBJP

cards.meaning: as long as... then... (a sufficient-condition connective, more formal/analytical than 如果)
cards.example: 只要经济不回暖，股市就难以起色。
cards.examplePinyin: zhǐyào jīngjì bù huínuǎn, gǔshì jiù nányǐ qǐsè
cards.exampleMeaning: As long as the economy doesn't warm up, the stock market will struggle to recover.
cards.note: 书面语/formal-analytical register — common in finance and policy speech. Unlike neutral 如果 ('if X, then Y' for any hypothetical), 只要 frames X as THE sufficient condition — a stronger claim that X alone guarantees Y.
cards.tiesTo: China's H1 listed-company earnings up 25.7% vs. CSI 300/STAR 50 sell-off

cards.meaning: disconnected, out of sync — a relationship/correlation between two things that should track together but no longer does
cards.example: 利润增长与股市表现脱节。
cards.examplePinyin: lìrùn zēngzhǎng yǔ gǔshì biǎoxiàn tuōjié
cards.exampleMeaning: Profit growth has become disconnected from stock-market performance.
cards.note: 书面语/formal register — literally 'to come apart at the joint,' used abstractly. Near-synonym 分离 (fēnlí) is more physical/literal (two objects pulled apart); 脱节 is specifically for a broken correlation between two things.
cards.tiesTo: China's H1 listed-company earnings up 25.7% vs. CSI 300/STAR 50 sell-off
